articles.title: Submarine crews and astronauts experience the same set of psychological pressures and have evolved opposite ways of handling them, and the difference reveals something about how isolation actually works.
articles.summary: A specific category of psychological research faces fragmentation, with findings and discussions appearing across two largely separate academic literatures. Despite researchers investigating identical conditions, their work is often compartmentalized. This highlights an ongoing challenge in integrating knowledge and fostering interdisciplinary communication within the psychological sciences, potentially hindering a unified understanding of complex human conditions.

articles.title: Casting News: Laura Linney Joins Lanterns, Virgin River Adds Landman Vet, And More
articles.summary: Laura Linney is set to join the cast of HBO's upcoming DC Comics superhero drama, "Lanterns." The network recently revealed her involvement in a new teaser. This significant casting addition brings another accomplished actor to the highly anticipated series, expanding the ensemble for what promises to be an engaging narrative within the DC universe on television.

articles.title: Apex Announces Brokered LIFE Offering of up to $10,001,600
articles.summary: A company plans to use funds from its recent offering to finance exploration activities for its Rift, CAP, and Lac Le Moyne projects. These proceeds will also support general working capital, signaling a strategic investment in expanding resource assessment and operational capabilities for future growth.

articles.title: 'I'm sorry Dave': NASA is working on an AI chip to help next-generation spacecraft think for themselves — so clearly they haven't seen 2001: A Space Odyssey
articles.summary: NASA has developed revolutionary autonomous spacecraft processors with dramatically higher computing performance. These new radiation-hardened chips deliver hundreds of times greater processing capability, enabling spacecraft to perform complex computations and make decisions independently in space. This significant technological advancement is crucial for enhancing future deep-space missions, facilitating advanced scientific exploration, and ensuring robust, self-reliant operations far from Earth.
